title: LR2021: expose detector index from GET_LORA_PACKET_STATUS
body:
The LR2021 supports multi-SF reception via side detectors configured through `setSideDetector()`. When a packet is received, the chip reports which detector (main or side 1/2/3) caught it in the response to `GET_LORA_PACKET_STATUS`. This information is currently read into `buff[5]` but only the RSSI LSBs (bits 1:0) are extracted -- the detector field in bits 5:2 is discarded.

Exposing this field would complete the multi-SF receive path: users can configure side detectors, receive packets on different spreading factors, but currently have no way to determine which detector/SF a given packet arrived on.

### Proposed change

Add an optional 7th parameter `uint8_t* detector = NULL` to `getLoRaPacketStatus()`:

**LR2021.h:**
int16_t getLoRaPacketStatus(uint8_t* cr, bool* crc, uint8_t* packetLen = NULL,
    float* snrPacket = NULL, float* rssiPacket = NULL,
    float* rssiSignalPacket = NULL, uint8_t* detector = NULL);

**LR2021_cmds_lora.cpp** (after the rssiSignalPacket block, before `return(state)`):
if(detector) { *detector = (buff[5] >> 2) & 0x0F; }

The value is a one-hot bitmask per the datasheet:
- `0x01` -- Main detector
- `0x02` -- Side detector 1
- `0x04` -- Side detector 2
- `0x08` -- Side detector 3

### Notes

- Fully backward-compatible: the new parameter defaults to `NULL`, so existing callers are unaffected.
- The data is already in `buff[5]` from the existing SPI read -- no additional chip communication needed.
- Follows the same optional-out-pointer pattern used by the other parameters in this function.
- We have already implemented this patch in our project and verified it is functional on hardware with multi-SF reception across 4 simultaneous spreading factors: https://github.com/dasmensch-su/Meshtastic-nRF54L15-LR2021-Multi-SF
